$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for elevated-operation parameter validation. Loaded and enforced INDEPENDENTLY by both the medium-integrity daemon (packages/privileged-helpers/src/operation-schema.js) and the high-integrity PowerShell host (os-adapters/windows-host/elevated-host.ps1). Neither side trusts the other to have validated. Every regex here must be valid in BOTH ECMAScript and .NET regex dialects - keep to the common subset (no lookbehind, no named groups, no \p{...}).

scope.label: Windows service name
scope.reason: service.restart scope contains invalid characters; a valid service name is letters, digits, dot, underscore, space or hyphen.

scope.label: Windows service name
scope.reason: service.setStartupType requires a valid service name scope.

startupType.reason: service.setStartupType requires startupType of Automatic, Manual, or Disabled.

scope.label: WinGet package id
scope.reason: package.install scope is not a valid package id.

scope.label: machine environment variable name
scope.reason: system.setEnvironmentVariable requires a valid machine variable name scope.

value.reason: system.setEnvironmentVariable requires a control-character-free string value under 8192 characters.

name.reason: system.setEnvironmentVariable name alias must match the scope exactly.

scope.label: hostname
scope.reason: system.hostsEntry.add requires a syntactically valid hostname scope.

address.reason: system.hostsEntry.add requires a syntactically valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
